policy.license_policy: Accept OSI-compatible and other lawfully redistributable open source source code, including GPLv2/v3, LGPL, MPL, MIT, BSD, Apache-2.0; review actual file/version, copyleft compatibility, source/build-script obligations, assets and aggregation boundaries per integration.
policy.technical_policy: Evaluate every shortlisted upstream. Prefer objectively better correctness/performance after fixtures and benchmarks; one implementation per mathematical operation, with adapters rather than parallel kernels.
policy.attribution: Keep upstream licenses/notices and source references; audit complete dependency graph and upstream license changes.
policy.funding: Worldwright is free open-source donationware; donations optional. License terms apply regardless of revenue and do not inherently prohibit charging.
policy.future_enterprise: Optional future enterprise service could be commercial; a future closed-source combined edition requires independent replacement of copyleft material and rights to contributors' work, not relabeling third-party code.
policy.ui_sources: See docs/dependencies/UI_CODE_REUSE.json for GIMP/Photon Studio/CADCraft; no source copied from Photon Studio without an actual redistributable code license.

order: Minimal adapter or isolated experimental integration
Accept/reject via accuracy fixtures and performance benchmarks
Promote to canonical shared service only after passing
review_process.decision_threshold: No redundant engine, failing license obligation, loss of precision/identity or unbounded memory; keep candidate on experiment branch otherwise
